title: الأعياد الرسمية في لبنان — الكتالوغ الكامل، 3 لغة (1978–2030)
description: Complete catalog of official public, governmental, school, bank, workday, Christian, and Hebrew holidays of Lebanon (لبنان) — extracted from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation. لبنان/Lubnan (Lebanon). Lebanese Republic — independence 1943. Country code: LB. Categories: bank, government, public. Multilingual names (3 languages: ar, en_US, fr). End-of-string `(estimated)/(observed)` parentheticals stripped from name columns and lifted into per-record `is_estimated`/`is_observed` boolean flags (per-language regex). No subdivisions — single national list.
